// Private experiment added to pflag v1.0.10; upstream files retain their licenses.
package pflag

// IsBuiltinConversion reports provenance captured before Value.Set was called.
// It is false for custom values and callback/Go-flag bridges, even if their Type
// claims a built-in name. Changing Flag.Value after failure cannot change it.
func (e *InvalidValueError) IsBuiltinConversion() bool { return e.builtin }

func builtinConversionValue(v Value) bool {
	switch v.(type) {
	case *boolValue, *boolSliceValue, *bytesHexValue, *bytesBase64Value,
		*countValue, *durationValue, *durationSliceValue,
		*float32Value, *float64Value, *float32SliceValue, *float64SliceValue,
		*intValue, *int8Value, *int16Value, *int32Value, *int64Value,
		*intSliceValue, *int32SliceValue, *int64SliceValue,
		*uintValue, *uint8Value, *uint16Value, *uint32Value, *uint64Value, *uintSliceValue,
		*ipValue, *ipSliceValue, *ipNetValue, *ipNetSliceValue, *ipMaskValue,
		*stringValue, *stringArrayValue, *stringSliceValue,
		*stringToIntValue, *stringToInt64Value, *stringToStringValue, *timeValue:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
